Meet Maya

She has tried a lot of mattresses.

Showroom after showroom, Maya lies down, closes her eyes and tries to guess how she will feel in a year. Every bed feels fine for two minutes. None of them feel like hers.

The shopping struggle

Too soft here, too firm there.

Her shoulders want to sink in. Her hips want to stay level. Most beds ask her to pick one and live with the other.

A better idea

The best suit isn't off the shelf.

You would never buy a suit by size alone. It gets taken in at the shoulders and let out at the waist until it fits you. Your bed can work the same way.

Meet TogetherBed

A bed that opens up.

Unzip the top and look inside. TogetherBed is built from blocks that sit side by side, with nothing glued in place, so every part can be chosen for you.

Zones and layers

Shoulders, hips and legs, each tuned.

Each side has three zones. In every zone, a comfort block sits on a support block. Choose plush, medium or firm on top and the support you need underneath.

And then there's Sam

Two people, one bed.

Maya sleeps on her side. Sam sleeps on his back. With TogetherBed, each side is built for the person sleeping on it, so neither of you has to meet in the middle.

Bodies change

Swap a section, keep the bed.

If one zone stops feeling right, you change that block, not the whole mattress. Your bed can keep up with you over the years.

Your turn

Find your fit, together.

Sleep Fit asks a few simple questions about how you sleep, then suggests a build for each side. It takes a few minutes, and you can do it side by side.
